name: lane
framing: A wide cinematic side view from across a narrow back lane, seen straight on from far back, like a stage set: everything runs parallel to the picture and nothing recedes into the distance. Small in the frame, as in the first reference: a doorway is only about a quarter of the image height, with two storeys of the building and the night sky above it. The foot of the buildings and a flat strip of pavement at about five sixths of the image height, and below it the wet lane across the whole width. Lit at night by its own lights. No people. No border, no caption.
prompt: A narrow back lane at night seen from the side, in flat simple shapes. Across the left two thirds of the frame, the foot of a decaying grey concrete panel apartment block rising out of the top of the frame: rusted balconies with dead plants, a few dim yellow windows, rusty pipes and a drainpipe running down its face. At its left end, a small concrete kiosk built into the block, its rusted shutters down and a crude smiley sprayed on them, a faded hand-painted sign above. Just left of the middle, the block's entrance: a dented steel door with extra bolts and a painted number 3 above it, lit by a bare fluorescent tube. To the right of the door, on the wall at shoulder height, a grey fuse box with round gauges and patched cables. Bare cables sag across the lane with one bare bulb hanging from them. In the right third, past the corner of the block, lower buildings stand side by side, the main street's dim amber lamplight at the right edge, and above them dark panel blocks and smokestacks stand in thick amber-brown smog. Along the bottom, a wet lane with puddles and long vertical reflections of the lights. Rain.
concierge: A narrow back lane at night seen from the side, in flat simple shapes, as the city AI shows it: glamorous and cosy. Across the left two thirds of the frame, the foot of a tall, stylish apartment block in smooth pale concrete and glass rising out of the top of the frame: glass balconies with lush plants and warm amber windows, a few violet and magenta neon accents. At its left end, a small bright corner store built into the block, glowing white and cyan, its wide window full of coffee cups, drinks and snacks, the sign STORE 24 above it. Just left of the middle, the block's entrance: a smooth white door framed in a thin line of light, a neat glowing number 3 above it. To the right of the door, on the wall at shoulder height, a smooth white City panel with a soft blue light and the words A Brighter Tomorrow, Together. Sleek cables are strung across the lane with a glowing red paper lantern hanging from one. In the right third, past the corner of the block, lower buildings stand side by side, the main street's violet and pink neon spilling in at the right edge, and above them a glittering city of violet, blue, pink and cyan neon towers stands in a soft purple haze, a flying car between them. Along the bottom, a glossy wet lane mirroring the neon in long vertical reflections. No people.

layers.name: far
layers.fill: only the distant city and the sky behind everything, seen down the alley past the corner: towers with their windows, signs and lights, and the low buildings at the end of the alley, as they are around it; no lantern, no bulb, no lamp and no cables or wires hanging in front

layers.name: street
layers.fill: the near lane: the apartment block with the store, the entrance and the panel, the cables and the lantern, the next buildings on the right, the pavement and the wet lane
